faq.q: What is the current price per sq.ft. for plots in Ambattur?
faq.a: Rates vary by location, approvals, and amenities — check recent comparables and official Ambattur guideline values for accurate stamp duty calculations.

faq.q: What is the minimum budget to buy a plot in Ambattur?
faq.a: Budget depends on plot size, location, and approvals. Include taxes, stamp duty, registration, and development charges when planning.

faq.q: What approvals are required for plots in Ambattur?
faq.a: A clear title, CMDA/DTCP sanctioned layout approval, an approved site plan, sale deed, encumbrance certificate showing no liens, and utility clearances.

faq.q: How do I verify the legal status of a plot in Ambattur?
faq.a: Check the title chain (sale deeds), encumbrance certificate at the sub-registrar's office, approved layout from CMDA/DTCP, land tax receipts, and mutation records. Engage a conveyance lawyer for a title search.

faq.q: Can NRIs buy plots in Ambattur?
faq.a: NRIs of Indian origin can generally purchase, subject to valid PAN, NRI status proof, and FEMA compliance.

faq.q: What appreciation can I expect on a plot in Ambattur?
faq.a: It depends on infrastructure upgrades and industrial/IT growth. Historical trends show steady appreciation in areas with improving connectivity and new projects.

faq.q: Are bank loans available for plot purchase in Ambattur?
faq.a: Loans are more restrictive than home mortgages. Banks require clear CMDA/DTCP approvals, good title, and a minimum plot size — check eligibility with multiple lenders before booking.

faq.q: What documents should I verify before purchase?
faq.a: Title deed chain, encumbrance certificate, CMDA/DTCP-approved layout, sale agreement, property tax receipts, seller identity proofs, NOCs, and mutation records — have a lawyer review all of it.

faq.q: How safe and livable is Ambattur as a residential area?
faq.a: An established industrial-residential suburb with growing infrastructure. Assess the specific pocket for development, street lighting, and proximity to hospitals and schools, and visit multiple times before deciding.
